issues.issue: Coapsă, Gambă, Genunchi and Călcâi are parts of the lower limb in ordinary Romanian picior usage; a narrow medical foot-only reading is not the group meaning. Carte, Revistă, Ziar and Abecedar are printed publications in the displayed identities. Century, year, week and calendar month are calendar units. Carpet beating during cleaning, beating egg whites and cream during preparation, and flattening the meat when preparing schnitzel are ordinary documented household/cooking uses of a bate. The label explicitly locates the operation in preparation or cleaning, not violence or hitting the finished dish. The three anchor groups and shared-verb group have no equally defensible complete repartition; obscurity is not the difficulty mechanism. Sources: https://dexonline.ro/definitie/picior ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/coaps%C4%83 ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/abecedar ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/bate/definitii ; https://www.oetker.ro/retete/r/tort-paula ; https://www.oetker-professional.ro/retete/tortul-padurea-neagra ; https://www.lauralaurentiu.ro/retete-culinare/retete-mancare/snitel-de-porc.html

Temă pentru acasă identifies the familiar assigned schoolwork task, not an abstract school category. The national education ministry uses the ordinary term for pupil assignments; notebooks, pencils, lessons and learning provide independent concrete classroom context and all five native predecessors are recognized. School, pupil and teacher guesses also give useful early feedback. The displayed task meaning makes no claim about current legal limits or required homework duration. Sources: https://www.edu.ro/press_rel_208_2025 ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/tem%C4%83 ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/caiet
